The National Spot Exchange Ltd (NSEL) on Monday said it has released a one-time settlement (OTS) payout of Rs 1,950 crore to eligible claimants, bringing closure to the Rs 5,600 crore payment default crisis after nearly 14 years of legal battle.
The Mumbai bench of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) had approved the settlement scheme. The full amount was deposited in a settlement account, with payouts to eligible specified creditors scheduled for November 23, 2026.
The money was paid to 63 Moons Technologies, which acted as assignee of the specified creditors.
On October 8, a special court in Mumbai allowed the monetisation of assets worth about Rs 3,464 crore that were attached by the Enforcement Directorate, to help fund the settlement.
The scheme was first proposed by the NSEL Investors Forum, an association representing a large number of traders. NSEL, backed by 63 Moons Technologies, accepted the proposal and filed it before the tribunal as a full and final settlement.
